_comment: Reference hooks from GUIDE.md Chapter 8.7. Review each before adding to your real ~/.claude/settings.json — some are macOS-only (notification), some assume specific tooling (Prettier, npm test). Do not copy wholesale.

PreToolUse._description: Block dangerous shell commands before they run.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(rm -rf|sudo rm|chmod 777|:(){:|:&};:)'; then echo 'Dangerous command blocked!' >&2; exit 2; fi

PreToolUse._description: Block reads or writes to secret-bearing files.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.(env|pem|key)$'; then echo 'Secret file access blocked' >&2; exit 2; fi

PreToolUse._description: Require passing tests before any git commit.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git commit'; then npm test --silent || (echo 'Tests must pass before commit' >&2 && exit 2); fi

SessionStart._description: Inject git status and recent TODOs into the session opener.

hooks.command: echo '## Git Status'; git status --short; echo '## TODO Comments'; grep -rn 'TODO:' src/ 2>/dev/null | head -5

Stop._description: macOS notification when the session ends.

hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude finished" with title "Claude Code"'
